title: FleshCatcher - The Original
description: The original FleshCatcher in all it's hideous glory.
body:
This is quite literally just a repost of the original FleshCatcher's 1.5.1 update, there's really not much to it.
________________________________________________________________________________________________
 
FleshCatcher's modern look fits the game quite well, right? Well this is the ORIGINAL one,
it's awful but we all start SOMEWHERE!

This version has few concepts that have carried into the modern one, so here's a list of the
more comprehensible ones:

The Organism: a much more barren yet much more vibrant version to the one you know and love.

scrung and gumblo: a pair of joke bosses that are cheats-only and serve basically no purpose.

Mobs: they hardly spawn and are more of just things you see and go "so this is why modern FleshCatcher had no mobs besides the Lostlin for a good while..."

Also, this is not an add-on to the modern FleshCatcher.
